en: The Dyad on Taints and Being Subject to Taints; The Triad on the Wholesome.

Conditioned by a state that is neither with-āsava nor without-āsava and is unwholesome, there arises a wholesome state that is both with-āsava and not without-āsava, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. One [condition] under root; ... pe ... one under non-disappearance.

Conditioned by a state that is neither with-āsava nor without-āsava and is unwholesome, there arises an unwholesome state that is both with-āsava and with-āsava, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three [conditions] under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is both with-outflows and not-with-outflows, and indeterminate, there arises a state that is both with-outflows and not-with-outflows, and indeterminate, by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. There are three under root; three under predominance … pe … three under non-disappearance.
